opening_range.definition: The range is the high and low of the first N minutes of the regular session. A break is any later trade past the range (as the Test-repo study counts it, even if price comes back inside); 'both' means both sides were taken at some point. Extension is the farthest travel past the range edge, in units of the range's own width, over the days that broke it. A cell with fewer than 30 events shows counts and no percentage.

words.2-2 reversal: two 2 bars in a row pointing opposite ways
words.2-2-2 shotgun: three 2 bars in a row, each opposite to the one before
words.2-1-2 completed: a 2, an inside bar, then a 2 bar
words.3-1-2 completed: an outside bar, an inside bar, then a 2 bar

strat_combos.note: Each name's last five daily labels, oldest first, grouped by their last two labels, plus the multi-bar patterns completed on the latest session. Labels only: no direction and nothing about what follows; a name can carry two completed patterns, so completed counts are pattern entries, not names.

reversal_wire.note: Reversal-shaped labels from the Strat bar rules on names trading at least $2M a day, dated to the session they belong to and never moved afterwards. Labels, not calls to act; names are listed for the latest session only.

expected_move.construction: The percent move priced for a session is the prior close of the VIX divided by 15.87; points are that percent of the fund's prior close, rounded to the nearest tenth; the week widens the rounded move by the square root of five and rounds again. VIX below 15 reads CALM, above 18.5 FAST, otherwise MIXED.
expected_move.note: A map from the VIX close, not a forecast of direction. 'Close inside' is how often the day's close stayed within the priced move over the desk's own daily history (a measured fact about the construction, not a claim about tomorrow).

record.note: Bands are written to the ledger before they are shown and graded when their horizon closes; the first live base session is the one shown here, so graded counts start at zero and accrue one session at a time.

corrected_band.construction: Half-width of the 68% band = recent movement (equal-weight mean of squared daily log returns over the last 1, 5 and 22 sessions, annualised) x sqrt(h/252) x k, with k = 0.87, 0.88, 0.91 at 1, 5, 21 sessions (the Test repo's AD-56 calibration for SPY). 50/81/95% bands scale that half-width by the normal quantile ratios; when the VIX is above the 3-month VIX the 95% band alone is widened by 1.25. No direction is forecast.

pullback_norm.definition: Depth is the distance from the name's own 63-session high, in units of its own median true range, shown as a percentile of that name's own trailing history (up to 750 sessions, today left out). 0 is shallower than ever in its history, 100 is deeper than ever.
pullback_norm.note: A descriptive reading of how deep each name's pullback is against its own history. The Test repo's own study of this idea is a research record, not a desk result; nothing here ranks names to buy.
